content: Dagha nǝ Yesu Damma Wurshalima
Hǝrzarǝt ba nǝ iitǝr daadamma Wursalima, kaa ghacǝgagacǝg kǝ iitǝr ma Betafaji ard Betani, vaka Gaval kwa dǝ Uufaha Zaituna, kaa ɓǝlgantɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ mbǝrzahaan buwa,
Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Damdǝg damma gǝdzǝrkǝsǝn tǝvuukwaruna. Baɗ daasaruwa am da nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ gǝlaaɓa aghyungngw nguɗanguɗana, kwa tapavǝnai ɗalgaan biya. Pǝlamdaapǝlga
Akwama ndavakurundavǝg nǝ uud taakiya, ‘Aujilbǝg kǝskuram pǝlgaani?’ ‘Am tagar taakiya, Yaazhigǝl wa naagaana, da gwiigaan saas bandakwan ndakwana.’ ”
Kaa dagal kǝ iitǝra, ar nǝgha kǝ gǝlaaɓa aghyungngw nguɗǝga tǝ ghaiya hǝnnyaha tǝ ɗuula. Ar tǝghǝrdǝga pǝlgaana,
am lii ghacǝga vaakwahiin taa kǝ iitǝra, “Am pǝllǝg damǝr kǝ aghyungwini?”
Kaa ngwangug kǝ mbǝrzahaan buna bakalkal bandkwa tagatǝr Yesu, kaa ɗuutǝrǝsɗuug kǝ uudahiin dagal dǝ aghyungngwiina.
Sarardǝv ba nǝ iitǝr kǝ aghyungngwǝn kǝ Yesu, ar ɓalǝt kǝ sǝɗavahaatǝr tǝ vakaiya, kaa ɗalgaan kǝ Yesu cǝhura tǝ vakaiya.
Kaa ɓalgaɓalǝg kǝ uudah kǝ sǝɗavahaatǝr baɗyak tǝ ɗuula, kyalǝmah dlaɓa ɓalara dǝva uufahi ghwadarda nǝ iitǝr saama guhaha.
Lii tǝvuukwana ard lii tǝ halaana ar ɗiyaru kǝ cau taakiya,

content.text: Bark kǝ tlǝkǝsǝrǝn da saayǝn kwa dǝga

content: Dagha ba nǝ Yesu damma Wurshalima, kaa daas kǝ iin damma gaagazaiya vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl vazǝna kǝ dǝgitah badǝmma, ɓǝlaaɓǝlǝg tsau ba hwaasa, kaa gwiyaghǝra daas ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaam damma Betani.
Tlafaatlafǝg nǝ Yesu Kǝ Uuffa Ghǝgyivva
Ciyarǝt ba nǝ iitǝr ma Betani dlakaduraana, kaa njǝkǝnjiig nǝ wai kǝ Yesu.

Nǝgha ba nǝ iin kǝ uufa ghǝgyiv kwad hyimiya, kaa da vazgaan mbatak tlǝkǝnatlǝg kǝ zǝr tǝ vakaiya. Dagha ba nǝ iin da tǝvǝgha, tlakǝnabi aanji ndau tǝ vakai biya, ba hyimiya, aɗaba sarta yaa zǝra ghǝgyiv biya.
Amaa taa kǝ uuffa ghǝgyivǝna, “Ba ɗǝmma aa gwiya zǝbbi nǝ uud kǝ zǝr tǝ kǝgh biya!” Cinngaracinng mbǝrzahaan kǝ dǝgiti tagada nǝ iina.
Yesu Ma Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla

Dagha ba nǝ Yesu damma wurshalima, kaa daas kǝ iin damma gaagazaiya Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla farzha kǝ lagwa lii sagwa dǝgitah ard lii vǝlgaana. Kaa tlagars dlaɓ baz tebǝraha lii mbǝɗa kwaɓa baz avǝdaha lii valla takalamasara.
Tsarva kǝ uudah kǝ ghwadadagal dǝ dǝgitah ma gaagazaiya Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla.
Kaa ba tsagtǝrtsag kǝ iin kǝ uudah amaa, “Vindavavindǝg taakiya,

content.text: Namdalnǝg nǝ uuram kwan kǝ ‘vakka shǝɓɓa gǝlaha.’ ”

content: Cinngaraba nǝ maalah ma zhiilakǝsuufah ar dǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muus kǝ kwanǝn kǝ ǝlbǝga, kaa fǝgarzhafǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ gata ɗuula tsǝgaana, aɗaba ar gǝdzǝgaana, kwakyarvad baɗǝm dzahava dlamakǝlaawǝn ar ɓa jappǝra tsagaanana.
Ɓǝlaa ba hwaasa, kaa mǝlla dagal kǝ Yesu ard Mbǝzahaan ma kǝssiina.
Ghulalghulǝg Nǝ Ghǝgyivvǝn Tlaffa nǝ Yesuna
Dlakadur bawur ar ghudadagala, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ ghǝgyivvǝn ghulalghulǝg tangw dat tlaliyaana.
Dzamghanidzamǝg Bitrusa, amaa taa kǝ Yesu, “Dadda tsaga dǝgita, zharga! Ghǝgyivvǝn tlafgha nǝngǝn ghulalghulǝgga!”
Ngwatǝrangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Famdǝghǝrǝtfǝg tǝ Daadamazhigǝla!

Bak jiir wan tagkurtaga, akwama fǝdghǝrǝtfǝg nǝ uud tǝ Daadamazhigǝla, tagardatag kǝ aghwǝn taakiya ciig ɓǝldǝmɓǝlg kǝ ghǝragh ma yiwahaiya. Akwama ɓagaabi kǝ ndaundawur ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaan tǝghǝr kǝ dǝgiti aa tag nǝ iin biya, da ɓagvarɓaga.
Mbakyarvad kwaha wan tagkurtaga, baɗǝm nǝ dǝgiti am ghalǝg nǝ uuram ma dzǝgwazhigǝla, famdǝghǝrǝtfǝga taakiya tlamkǝnatlǝga, da nǝg kǝ dǝgaruwa.

Dlaɓa makwar kǝ sarti am ciigǝt nǝ uuram da dzugwazhigǝla, akwama mǝng dadda kwamma hǝkyna nǝ uuram ma ǝrviɗya, am ɓǝsharnana, aɗaba ghǝrava Daadaruwi maghǝrazhigǝl ndakwani da ɓǝshkurna kǝ haipaharuwa.”
Aiciya, akwamam maay ɓǝstǝrnaɓǝshǝg kǝ haipahaatǝr kǝ uudah biya, daadaruwi ma ghǝrazhigǝl ndakwani da maay ɓǝshkuranaaɓishǝg biya.
Ar Ɓa Ndaundawur Tǝghǝr Kǝ Ndzǝɗɗa Yesu

Kaa gwiya daas kǝ iitǝr damma Wurshalima. Kaa gwaiyav kǝ Yesu ma gaagazaiya vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, kaa sagau kǝ lii maalah ma zhiilakǝsuufaha, ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muusa, ard maalah tǝghǝr kǝ vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla sa vakaana.
Am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Agha ɓag dǝ kwar kǝ ndzǝɗ nǝng kwanahaan kǝ dǝgitahi? Warwa vǝlakak ndzǝɗa ɓaagaani?”
Am Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Mǝng nǝ ndavǝgi ǝn na ndavkuru naiya. Am nguwi ghǝravaruwa, kai ndakwi ǝnda tagkurtag ma hulfa kwar kǝ ndzǝɗ wan ɓag nai kǝ tlǝr dǝ vakaiya.
Tagamwataga, ndzǝɗǝn ɓagga Yuhwan kǝ tsufǝg dǝ vakaiyǝntsa, vǝlghar Daadamazhigǝl nii uudhi?”
Kaa fǝgarzhafǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ agajaw ma taatakaatǝr, taakiya, “Akwama tagǝyamatag taaki, ‘Vak Daadamazhigǝla,’ da tagkiyamtag taakiya, ‘Aujilbǝg famdǝghǝrǝt bi tǝ iin biyi?’
Kiyam tagatag taaki, ‘Vak kǝ uud kwana?’” (Ar gǝdza dǝgiti da ɓagtǝr nǝ uudaha, aɗaba baɗǝm nǝ uudah kǝsarantkǝsǝg taakiya tlayanga Daadamazhigǝl nǝ Yuhwana.)
Kaa ngugarangug kǝ iitǝr kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Kǝm sǝrga biya.” Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Kai ndakwi ǝn maay tagkurtag kǝ ndzǝɗi ǝn ɓag nai kǝ tlǝr dǝ vakai biya.”
